info.title: AgroLens API
info.description: Monthly crop-stress risk and rotation comparison for Irish farms. This tool supports, not replaces, your judgment and local agronomic advice.

get.summary: DB, cache and model are usable

post.summary: Create a field from a point + approximate area, or from a drawn polygon

get.summary: Climate summary, trends, soil and satellite history for a field

post.summary: Monthly probability of crop stress for a field, with uncertainty and reasons
Compare the current rotation with alternatives, weighted by the farmer's priorities

get.summary: Map layers: NASA GIBS + our risk grid
Pilot grid as GeoJSON with the stress risk per cell for one month
